info.name: Fighting Style Category Feats
info.description: The Fighting Style Category Feats from Arcana Unleashed.

description.p: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)

You learn two Wizard cantrips of your choice. Mage Hand and Ray of Frost are recommended. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).
Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Wizard cantrip.
Your spellcasting ability for your chosen Wizard cantrips is Intelligence.

sheet.description: You can cast this feat's cantrips using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. When you gain a level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Wizard cantrip.

description.p: Your spellcasting ability for your chosen Wizard cantrips is Wisdom.

sheet.description: You can cast this feat's cantrips using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. When you gain a level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Wizard cantrip.
